warning: Hand-authored synthetic examples for development and pipeline verification only. This is not real grievance data and must not be used to claim production accuracy.

examples.subject: Ration not distributed
examples.description: The fair price shop has not given our family the monthly food ration despite a valid ration card.

examples.subject: Ration shop overcharging
examples.description: The dealer at the public distribution shop demands extra money before issuing subsidized rice and wheat.

examples.subject: Ration card correction pending
examples.description: My application to correct family members on the ration card has been pending at the food supply office for months.

examples.subject: Biometric failure at fair price shop
examples.description: The ration shop fingerprint machine repeatedly rejects my identity and the dealer refuses to provide the monthly quota.

examples.subject: Missing monthly ration quota
examples.description: Several households have not received their essential grain allocation from the government ration outlet this month.

examples.subject: Frequent electricity outages
examples.description: Our neighborhood has long unscheduled power cuts every evening and the local electricity office has not repaired the supply.

examples.subject: Incorrect electricity bill
examples.description: The power utility charged an unusually high amount even though our meter reading and household usage have not changed.

examples.subject: Transformer sparks near homes
examples.description: A damaged electrical transformer is sparking beside houses and the electricity board has not sent a repair team.

examples.subject: New power connection delayed
examples.description: I paid the required fee for a household electricity connection but the distribution company has not installed the meter.

examples.subject: Electricity pole leaning
examples.description: A power distribution pole is leaning over the street and exposed wires have remained unsafe after repeated complaints.

examples.subject: No drinking water supply
examples.description: Tap water has not reached our residential area for several days and families cannot obtain clean drinking water.

examples.subject: Water pipeline leak
examples.description: A public water main is leaking into the road and the supply pressure in nearby homes has become very low.

examples.subject: Contaminated tap water
examples.description: The municipal drinking water is brown and has a foul smell, but no water quality inspection has been arranged.

examples.subject: Rural hand pump broken
examples.description: The village hand pump used for drinking water has stopped working and residents have no nearby water source.

examples.subject: Delayed water connection
examples.description: My application for a household water connection remains pending even though the connection charges were paid.

examples.subject: Large potholes on public road
examples.description: Deep potholes on the main road are causing accidents and damage to vehicles, and repair work has not started.

examples.subject: Highway surface damaged
examples.description: A section of the national highway has broken pavement and unsafe craters that need urgent resurfacing.

examples.subject: Bridge repair required
examples.description: The public road bridge has cracked barriers and damaged joints, creating a danger for buses and other traffic.

examples.subject: Road construction unfinished
examples.description: Road construction was abandoned halfway, leaving loose gravel and an unusable route for residents.

examples.subject: Damaged road not repaired
examples.description: The access road has eroded after rain and repeated requests to the roads department have not resulted in repairs.

examples.subject: Medicine unavailable at hospital
examples.description: The government hospital pharmacy has no prescribed essential medicines and patients are being asked to buy them privately.

examples.subject: Primary health centre closed
examples.description: The public primary health centre is frequently closed during working hours and villagers cannot see a doctor.

examples.subject: Delayed hospital treatment
examples.description: My appointment for a necessary procedure at the government hospital has been postponed repeatedly without explanation.

examples.subject: Vaccination service unavailable
examples.description: The local public clinic has not conducted the scheduled immunization session for children this month.

examples.subject: Ambulance did not arrive
examples.description: The public ambulance service did not respond to an emergency call and the district health helpline did not assist.

examples.subject: Scholarship payment delayed
examples.description: I have not received my scholarship amount for three months despite submitting all required student documents.

examples.subject: School scholarship application pending
examples.description: My education scholarship application is verified but the student financial assistance has not been credited to my account.

examples.subject: Government school lacks teachers
examples.description: The public school has had vacant teaching posts for months and students are missing their regular classes.

examples.subject: School certificate not issued
examples.description: The government school has not issued my transfer certificate despite repeated applications from my parent.

examples.subject: Scholarship funds not credited
examples.description: After submitting the required education documents, I am still waiting for the student scholarship installment.

examples.subject: Pension payment stopped
examples.description: My government retirement pension has not been deposited for several months even though life certificate documents were submitted.

examples.subject: Pension application delayed
examples.description: The pension office has not processed my retirement benefits claim after receiving all service records.

examples.subject: Incorrect pension amount
examples.description: My monthly government pension is lower than the approved amount and the pension authority has not corrected it.

examples.subject: Family pension not started
examples.description: The family pension for my deceased government employee spouse has not begun despite filing the required forms.

examples.subject: Retirement arrears pending
examples.description: My approved retirement pension arrears and gratuity remain unpaid by the government pension office.

examples.subject: Street lights not working
examples.description: Street lights on our municipal road have been dark for weeks, making the area unsafe for pedestrians at night.

examples.subject: Garbage not collected
examples.description: The municipal sanitation team has not collected waste from our street and rubbish is accumulating near homes.

examples.subject: Blocked city drain
examples.description: A neighborhood stormwater drain maintained by the city is blocked and wastewater is flooding the footpath.

examples.subject: Public park maintenance
examples.description: The city park equipment is damaged and overgrown vegetation has made the municipal public space unusable.

examples.subject: Municipal property service request
examples.description: My request for a municipal birth certificate correction has remained pending at the city office.

examples.subject: Police complaint not registered
examples.description: The local police station refuses to register my complaint about a theft despite providing the incident details.

examples.subject: No response to police helpline
examples.description: I called the police emergency helpline about a safety incident but no officer came to the location.

examples.subject: Lost document report delayed
examples.description: The police station has not issued an acknowledgment for my lost identity document report after several visits.

examples.subject: Police investigation stalled
examples.description: No progress has been made in the police investigation of my filed case and the investigating officer is unreachable.

examples.subject: Request for police verification
examples.description: My police verification application is pending at the station although all requested identity documents were submitted.

examples.subject: Land record ownership error
examples.description: The government land records show an incorrect owner for my plot and the correction request has not been processed.

examples.subject: Mutation application pending
examples.description: The revenue office has not completed the land mutation in my name despite submitting the registered deed.

examples.subject: Survey map discrepancy
examples.description: The official cadastral map places my boundary incorrectly and the land survey correction is still pending.

examples.subject: Property record copy delayed
examples.description: I cannot obtain a certified copy of my government land ownership record from the district revenue office.

examples.subject: Land tax receipt correction
examples.description: The land revenue receipt contains an incorrect survey number and the local records department has not amended it.

examples.subject: Biometric ration authentication failure
examples.description: The fair price shop terminal cannot verify my fingerprint and the dealer refuses to issue the subsidized food allocation.

examples.subject: Low voltage from distribution line
examples.description: Household appliances fail because the electricity distribution line supplies dangerously low voltage through the evening.

examples.subject: Household water service connection delayed
examples.description: The water utility has not connected my home to the drinking water pipeline although the service fee was paid.

examples.subject: Potholes on district road
examples.description: Repeated vehicle impacts have damaged the paved district road and residents have requested repair from the roads authority.

examples.subject: Government hospital appointment cancelled
examples.description: The public hospital cancelled my specialist appointment several times and has not arranged the needed medical consultation.

examples.subject: Government school classroom shortage
examples.description: Students at the public school are crowded into one classroom because the promised additional teaching rooms were not provided.

examples.subject: Life certificate pension verification
examples.description: My retirement pension remains withheld even though the pension office accepted my annual proof of life document.

examples.subject: Public street lamps failed
examples.description: Municipal lighting fixtures beside the town bus stop have stopped illuminating the road at night, creating a pedestrian safety risk.

examples.subject: Police report acknowledgement missing
examples.description: The police station has not provided an acknowledgement number for the complaint I registered about a stolen phone.

examples.subject: Property mutation not recorded
examples.description: The revenue authority has not updated the government land register with the new owner after a registered property transfer.
